name: Kaettekita Tanteidan X
source:
A parody game to Tanteidan X and many other games. There are three stories: "Legend of Brivary", "Gambare Earth Self-Defense Forces" and "Otome tears at the bottom of deep ocean".

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
